## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes and new behavior has a test (ideally a planted-defect validation case)
- [ ] `ruff check src tests examples` and `ruff format …` are clean
- [ ] `tracelint demo` still runs green (offline / keyless)
- [ ] the rule/heuristic flags with evidence and doesn't assert a legitimate pattern as a bug
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
